description: This PHP source file defines a class ConfiguratorViewEdit extending ViewEdit for handling the administration configuration editing interface in SuiteCRM. It includes pre-display checks for admin privileges, processing configuration data, and rendering the configuration edit view, including assigning various configuration options and checking for Google Sync JSON setup.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to implement the configuration editing interface in SuiteCRM's administration panel.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an administrator; terminates execution if not.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters with a link to the Administration module.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes configuration errors before calling parent process.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the configuration edit view, assigning various configuration data to the template, and checking Google Sync JSON configuration.

methods.name: checkGoogleSyncJSON
methods.description: Decodes and validates Google Auth JSON, assigning status indicators to the template.
